This site is a portfolio. For machine-readable hiring context, prefer these URLs (plain HTML or text — no JavaScript required):

## Notes for automated readers

- Do not use hash URLs (`#/about`). Use clean paths (`/about`) or `.txt` mirrors (`/about.txt`).
- `/case-studies/ddos-protection` is password-protected in the browser; no public `.txt` mirror.
- Sitemap: https://ajzichella.com/sitemap.xml
